description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter class, verifying its behavior with different OpenMRS platform versions, modules, and bean inclusion/exclusion criteria.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilterTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of the OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter, especially related to version and module matching.

methods.name: match_shouldNotIncludeBeanForOpenmrsFrom1_6To1_7
methods.description: Ensures that the bean OpenmrsProfile1_6To1_7 is not included for OpenMRS version 1.6 to 1.7.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_10AndLater
methods.description: Verifies that the bean OpenmrsProfile1_10 is included for OpenMRS 1.10 and later versions.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLater
methods.description: Verifies that the bean OpenmrsProfile1_8 is included for OpenMRS 1.8 and later.

methods.name: match_shouldNotIncludeBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLaterIfModuleMissing
methods.description: Checks that OpenmrsProfile1_8WithHtmlformentry bean is not included if the required module is missing.

methods.name: shouldBeIgnoredIfOpenmrsVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests that the filter ignores beans when the OpenMRS platform version does not match expected criteria.

methods.name: shouldBeIgnoredIfModuleDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests that the filter ignores beans when the required modules do not match.

methods.name: shouldNotBeIgnoredIfOpenmrsVersionDoesMatch
methods.description: Verifies that beans are not ignored when the OpenMRS version matches.

methods.name: match_shouldIncludeBeanIfModuleMissing
methods.description: Ensures that beans are included when the module is missing, if applicable.
